- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.67) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.33) — add 1–3% to forecast to avoid missing downside.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >80.00) — cap forecast at +5% above peak or adjust downward 2–5% if sentiment turns neutral.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is >10% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 2–4% unless sentiment supports continuation.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.33 after 3–5 days, reduce forecast 1–2% per day until sentiment recovers.
- Horizon-specific: 30d forecasts often overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen by 1–3% if sentiment is volatile or recent.
